statement: Achieved ISO 14001:2015 implementation of environmental management system
Over the past year, we have taken definitive steps towards reducing our environmental footprint, improving energy efficiency, and prioritizing health and safety across our operations.
Our commitment to global standards in quality, environment, and occupational health & safety is reflected in our ISO 14001:2015 certification at our facility in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh.
We maintain a strong focus on sustainability and compliance through renewable power integration at our operations.
Pollution Control Systems and scrubbers ensure adherence to strict air quality norms across all facilities.
Water recycling and zero liquid discharge (ZLD) systems minimize fresh water usage and safeguard resources.
Green belt development enhances biodiversity, reduces dust, and improves the local environment.

Environmental regulations and global sustainability trends are also prompting foundries to shift from traditional coke-fired and coal-fired melting to induction and electric arc furnaces, which require significant capital investment.
With the deployment of a continuous sand mixer towards the end of the year we were able to significantly improve our moulding sand.
Our captive solar power plant helps us in reducing approximately 3400MT of carbon emissions yearly, while reducing our energy costs.
This also allows us to reduce our carbon footprint, which is a dire need of today’s environment.
Our customers can also reduce their carbon footprint by sourcing from us.

Ensuring environmental sustainability, ecological balance, protection of flora and fauna, animal welfare, agro forestry, conservation of natural resources and maintaining quality of soil, air and water including contribution to the Clean Ganga Fund set-up by the Central Government for rejuvenation of river Ganga.

Horticulture plantation, agro farm forestry, afforestation, projects on non-conventional energy (biogas), animal husbandry programs, forest conservation projects, water resource management and soil conservation, promoting micro-irrigation etc.
The Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981 is specifically applicable to the company.
The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974 is specifically applicable to the company.
The Environment Protection Act, 1986 is specifically applicable to the company.
